limitations: 分析方法可用；行情、数据源和专有工具需配置并验证。

sourceMetadata.name: catalyst-calendar
sourceMetadata.description: Use when building public-equity-investing catalyst calendars. Do not use for full event underwriting; use event-driven-analyzer.

sourceMetadata.name: company-tearsheet
sourceMetadata.description: Use when creating source-backed public issuer tearsheets. Do not use for private diligence, fund diligence, vendors, or market maps.

sourceMetadata.name: comps-valuation
sourceMetadata.description: Produce Public Equity Investing comparable-company valuation in report or workbook mode. Use for peer selection, multiple analysis, valuation read-throughs, implied prices, comps dashboards, Excel or Sheets comps, refreshable peer tables, model updates, and comps workbook QA. Do not use for DCF-only, credit-security, or generic market commentary requests.

sourceMetadata.name: dcf-model-builder
sourceMetadata.description: Use when building public-equity DCF valuation workbooks. Default to the banker formula workbook path for new model builds; use deterministic exports only for controlled support calculations or explicit lightweight runs. Do not use for standalone workbook audits; use model-audit-tieout.

sourceMetadata.name: deck-report-qc
sourceMetadata.description: Use when running first-pass QC on Public Equity Investing decks or reports. Do not use as external-circulation certification.

sourceMetadata.name: earnings-deep-dive
sourceMetadata.description: Use when analyzing public-company earnings after results, guidance, transcript, or call commentary. Do not use for pre-print previews.

sourceMetadata.name: earnings-preview
sourceMetadata.description: Use when preparing full pre-earnings preview reports with executive summary, expectation bar, guidance credibility, KPI dashboard, scenarios, and call questions. Do not use after results or for short summaries unless the user explicitly asks for a summary/short version.

sourceMetadata.name: economic-impact-report
sourceMetadata.description: Use when translating a specific event, policy change, macro shock, or industry development into public-equity issuer, sector, earnings, valuation, positioning, and portfolio implications. Do not use for standalone macro strategy, rates, FX, credit, futures, or generic market commentary.

sourceMetadata.name: equity-model-update
sourceMetadata.description: Safely update public-company Excel model copies from source-to-model maps; emits XLSX as the hero artifact and CSV/log/manifest as support. Do not use for pure earnings notes or broad workbook audits.

sourceMetadata.name: event-driven-analyzer
sourceMetadata.description: Use when analyzing dated public-equity event paths, probabilities, payoffs, and expected returns. Do not use for generic catalyst lists, risk sizing, hedges, capital structure, covenants, or credit recovery.

sourceMetadata.name: financials-normalizer
sourceMetadata.description: Use when normalizing public-company financials from source materials. Do not use for private data rooms or non-financial cleanup.

sourceMetadata.name: idea-generation
sourceMetadata.description: Use when triaging public-equity idea candidates. Do not use for final trade recommendations, pitches, memos, or models.

sourceMetadata.name: initiating-coverage
sourceMetadata.description: Use when building public-equity-investing initiating coverage reports. Do not use for trade pitches, memos, earnings notes, models, or tearsheets.

sourceMetadata.name: long-short-pitch
sourceMetadata.description: Use when building PM-facing Public Equity Investing trade pitches, including sparse-context or partial-section requests. Do not use for formal memos; use memo-builder.

sourceMetadata.name: meeting-prep
sourceMetadata.description: Use when creating Public Equity Investing meeting prep briefs. Do not use for private diligence, IB, FP&A, legal, or scheduling-only tasks.

sourceMetadata.name: memo-builder
sourceMetadata.description: Use when drafting or reviewing formal public-equity investment memos. Do not use for live trade construction or credit-first memos; use long-short-pitch or Credit Markets as appropriate.

sourceMetadata.name: model-audit-tieout
sourceMetadata.description: Use when auditing existing Public Equity Investing models or spreadsheets. Do not use to build a new model from scratch.

sourceMetadata.name: portfolio-risk-management
sourceMetadata.description: Use when sizing Public Equity Investing positions, finding equity hedges, or building an integrated position-and-hedge risk plan from a listed-equity thesis. Do not use for thesis construction, standalone event underwriting, trade execution, personal investment advice, or credit-instrument risk.

sourceMetadata.name: public-equity-investing
sourceMetadata.description: Route Public Equity Investing workflows for listed-company and public-security research, earnings analysis, valuation, model updates, long/short pitches, catalysts, thesis tracking, ETF/index and constituent diligence, position sizing, hedging, dashboards, and investment memos. Use when the user is evaluating a public company, ticker, sector, portfolio position, event, earnings setup, or investment thesis through an investor lens, including what is priced in, what is mispriced, what proves or kills the thesis, and what to watch next. Do not use for private-company diligence, credit-first analysis, personal financial advice, generic company summaries, or generic document drafting with no public-equity investment context.

sourceMetadata.name: scenario-sensitivity-generator
sourceMetadata.description: Use when turning a public-equity base case, model, thesis, event, or catalyst into scenario skew, sensitivity, breakpoint, and PM action-threshold analysis. Do not use for first-pass model builds, credit-security valuation, or generic planning.

sourceMetadata.name: thesis-tracker
sourceMetadata.description: Use when building or updating Public Equity Investing thesis trackers. Do not use for generic news summaries, trade pitches, or first-pass memos.

sourceMetadata.name: three-statement-model-builder
sourceMetadata.description: Use when building public-equity three-statement operating model workbooks. Default to the banker formula workbook path for new model builds; use deterministic exports only for controlled support calculations or explicit lightweight runs. Do not use for standalone workbook audits.

sourceMetadata.name: user-context
sourceMetadata.description: Initialize, inspect, save, update, forget, export, or explicitly reset the Public Equity Investing plugin's local user context, source setup, or optional automation setup. Use only when the user explicitly asks to manage Public Equity Investing saved preferences, source pointers, context storage, or recurring automation.
